metadata.title: Uber’s Delivery Business Catches Up to Ride-Sharing. Robo-Taxis Are Next. <!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Uber’s Delivery Business Narrows Gap With Ride-Sharing. Now Comes the Robo-Taxi Push.
Uber reported better-than-expected third-quarter earnings Wednesday as its fast-growing delivery business continued to close the gap with its core ride-hailing operations ahead of a planned expansion of its robo-taxi fleet.
